layout.clueText: Send a nameplate, old-part photo, or machine details for specialist review.

home.intro: Search by part number, OEM, machine model, engine model, or part name. Incomplete information is enough to begin.
home.catalogueTitle: Start with a machine or part category
home.shortcutError: Some shortcuts could not be loaded. Try again.
home.required: Enter a part clue to search.

auto.label: All clues
auto.placeholder: Part number / OEM / machine / engine / part name
auto.hint: Automatically identifies numbers, models, and natural-language clues

part_no.label: Part number
part_no.hint: Spaces, hyphens, and letter case are supported

machine.label: Machine model
machine.placeholder: Enter brand and model, e.g. Komatsu PC200-8
machine.hint: Put the brand before the model, separated by a space

engine.label: Engine model
engine.placeholder: Enter the nameplate engine model, e.g. 1DZ-II
engine.hint: Use the model printed on the engine nameplate

search.missingText: Enter a part number, OEM, or machine model on the home page.
search.loading: Checking the catalogue, fitments, and cross-references…
search.title: Technical review for “{{query}}”
search.multipleText: Compare the nameplate and machine serial number, then choose one candidate before adding it.
search.notFoundTitle: No matching part in the catalogue
search.insufficientTitle: A few key details are still needed
search.nextText: Add the brand, full model, machine nameplate, or old-part photos to narrow the result. Existing data will be carried into the inquiry.

cartAction.failed: Could not add the part. Try again
cartAction.riskText: This match needs additional verification. Check the machine model, serial number, and physical specifications; an incorrect part may affect machine safety.

detail.errorTitle: Unable to load the part data sheet
detail.noFitment: The API has no fitment data. Verify manually before use.
detail.noSpec: The API has no specifications, packaging, units, or notices.

batch.title: Turn a purchase sheet into a reviewable match job
batch.intro: Download a localized template and enter up to 500 rows of machine and part clues. Each row is validated independently.
batch.templateText: Choose the language used to complete the sheet. Interface language: {{lang}}.
batch.chooseHint: or choose a file from this device

cart.title: Procurement list
cart.intro: Review fitment and quantity line by line, then send the list to a parts specialist for pricing.
cart.saveFailed: Could not save quantity; previous value restored
cart.removeFailed: Could not remove the item. Try again
cart.safetyText: For safety-critical parts, verify the machine model, serial number, and physical specifications.
cart.noPaymentShort: No online payment in this release; inquiry only
cart.emptyText: Add parts requiring a quote from search results or a part data sheet.
cart.removeText: Remove “{{name}}” from the list. You will need to search again to re-add it.
cart.countryHint: Optional; helps confirm time zone and delivery scope
cart.contactHint: Enter the account, phone, or email for the selected tool
cart.notePlaceholder: Delivery timing, quantity details, or checks requiring attention
cart.noPayment: Online payment is not supported in this release. A specialist will confirm price and delivery.
cart.orderStatus: Status: {{status}} · A specialist will contact you using the details provided.

upload.title: Turn a nameplate into reviewable part clues
upload.intro: Confirm the photo type, then let the system read text, extract fields, and check the catalogue.
upload.light: Use even light and avoid glare
upload.frame: Keep the full nameplate and all corners in frame
upload.drop: Drop images into the alignment frame
upload.formats: JPG / JPEG / PNG / WebP / HEIC · up to 5
upload.addOne: Add at least one image to begin
upload.max: You can upload up to 5 images
upload.maxExtra: Only 5 images were added; extra files were ignored
upload.slow: Processing has taken over 10 seconds. Images are still being handled securely; wait or cancel and retry later.

OCR_EMPTY.title: No text was detected
OCR_EMPTY.detail: Enter the nameplate fields below and the system will search with your confirmed information.

IMAGE_BLURRY.title: The photo is too blurry
IMAGE_BLURRY.detail: Return to upload and take a sharply focused photo without glare.

HEIC_OCR_UNSUPPORTED.title: HEIC recognition is unavailable
HEIC_OCR_UNSUPPORTED.detail: Export the photo as JPG, PNG, or WebP and upload it again.

IMAGE_DECODE_FAILED.title: The image format could not be read
IMAGE_DECODE_FAILED.detail: The file may be damaged. Export the image again and retry.

part_photo: Whole old part, interfaces, and numbers

inquiry.title: Give scattered clues to a parts specialist
inquiry.intro: Fill this out like a machine service sheet. Previous-step data is prefilled; complete the contact details.
inquiry.contactText: The specialist will only contact you through the selected tool.
inquiry.name: Contact name *
inquiry.contactHint: Enter a phone number, username, or account
inquiry.machineText: Unknown fields may be left blank; copy the original text exactly.
inquiry.partText: Describe the name, old number, installation position, or fault.
inquiry.notePlaceholder: Installation position, delivery date, or checks requiring attention
inquiry.photoUpload: Upload nameplate, old-part, or packaging photos
inquiry.requiredContact: Enter the account or number for the selected tool
inquiry.invalidQuantity: Quantity must be an integer from 1 to 100000
inquiry.maxImages: Each ticket can include up to 20 images
inquiry.submitFailed: Submission failed. Check the information and try again
inquiry.expiresText: Success details are kept briefly in this browser. Submit again or enter the ticket number.

inquirySuccess.queue: Manual inquiry is in the review queue
inquirySuccess.hint: A parts specialist usually starts within one business day and will use your selected communication tool if more details are needed.
inquirySuccess.fallback: Support will use your selected communication tool; there is no need to submit again.
inquirySuccess.notFound: Ticket not found. Check the full number and use the browser that submitted it.

batchResult.duplicateText: Confirmation is required before adding; quantities for the same part will be merged.

notFound.title: This page is not in the parts catalogue
notFound.text: The link may have expired or the address may be incorrect. Return home to continue searching.
